name: pwm_controller
description: Parameterized PWM controller with synchronous active-low reset, programmable duty cycle and period, free-running enable-gated counter, and combinational PWM output generation.

fixed_assumptions: All sequential state updates occur on the rising edge of clk.
Counter behavior is synchronous to clk and gated by enable.
period and duty_cycle are interpreted as unsigned 8-bit values.
PWM output is purely combinational from the current counter_value and duty_cycle.

feature_contracts.description: Asserting reset_n forces the counter output to zero and therefore deasserts PWM output.
With reset released and enable high, the counter increments once per cycle until terminal count.
When the counter reaches the programmed period value, the next enabled cycle wraps the counter to zero.
PWM output is high only while counter_value is strictly less than duty_cycle.
When enable is low, the counter holds its present value and PWM output continues to reflect that held count.

functionality: Implements a programmable pulse-width modulation generator. When reset_n is low, all state is cleared to zero. When reset_n is high and enable is asserted, the internal counter increments once per clock cycle. The counter wraps to zero when it reaches the programmed period value. The PWM output is asserted whenever the current counter_value is strictly less than duty_cycle, allowing duty cycle control from 0 to 255 counts. The design is fully synthesizable and suitable for direct RTL implementation without hierarchy.
responsibilities: Apply programmable terminal count based on period.
Generate combinational PWM output from counter_value and duty_cycle.
Provide counter_value as an observable output for status/debug.
Honor synchronous reset behavior and enable gating.
reset_behavior: When reset_n is low, counter_value shall be driven to 8'b0 on the next active clock edge and remain zero while reset_n stays low. pwm_out shall be low during reset because counter_value is zero and the output is derived combinationally. No other internal state is retained or initialized.
behavior_rules: counter_value updates only on rising clk edges when reset_n is high.
If enable is low, counter_value holds its current value.
If enable is high and counter_value equals period, the next counter_value becomes zero.
If enable is high and counter_value is less than period, the next counter_value increments by one.
pwm_out shall be 1 when counter_value < duty_cycle; otherwise pwm_out shall be 0.
The output comparison uses the current visible counter_value, not the next counter value.
All arithmetic is unsigned and 8-bit wide; wrap/compare behavior must be consistent with synthesizable RTL semantics.
No clock gating is permitted; enable is used only in synchronous control logic.
